example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথায় সবাই হেসে কানমলা খাইল।
ভুল সিদ্ধান্তের জন্য সে কানমলা খেয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone laughed at his words and he was humiliated.
He was disgraced for his wrong decision.
note: This idiom draws from the unpleasant idea of consuming something dirty to symbolize embarrassment.
